title: Kit 3.2.6 migration safety
reason: Upgrade from 3.2.5: refresh the installed fleet engine, then rerun memory-fleet.mjs --project-gates; repo.git-skipped no longer feeds warn-autofix, and metrics.fleet.warnProjectsByCheck shows counted IDs. Router trigger overflow stays on separate normalized router rows. No project action for brain mirror exclusion, synthetic fixtures, or STARTER correction. If routes --write ran on 3.2.5, compare MEMORY.md with its pre-migration Git version and restore any table-row trigger now only in index-notes-*.md. Run: `git -C <MEMORY_GIT_ROOT> diff <PRE_MIGRATION_COMMIT> -- <MEMORY_RELATIVE_DIR>/MEMORY.md <MEMORY_RELATIVE_DIR>/index-notes-*.md`. Use . for MEMORY_RELATIVE_DIR in a separate memory repo. After restoring triggers run: `node <PROJECT>/scripts/memory/memory-check.mjs --repo <PROJECT> --memory-dir <MEMORY_DIR>`.

title: Kit 3.2.7 capture and enforcement
reason: Upgrade from 3.2.6: check and apply, inspect settings and capture hints, repair characters and chains, classify kinds, convert legacy repeats and decide escalations, then gate and report fleet health. Starter guard rules warn; replay before host overrides opt into deny.

title: Kit 3.2.8 lesson casebook
reason: Upgrade from 3.2.7: preview and apply; verify installed LESSON-KINDS.md and settings present, preserve host files, gate, round-trip kind_case via new and classify, and label every row independently and score the pair with classify --score A.json B.json (at most 6 of 40 disagreements, scaled); person-set labels are hand-set takeaways. See LABELLING.md.

title: Kit 3.2.9 generic documentation
reason: Upgrade from 3.2.8: preview and apply to refresh generic guides, skills and synthetic self-test fixtures. Wording only; no behaviour change. Commands, flags, caps and detections are unchanged; preserve host edits and run the installed gate.

title: Kit 3.2.10 plain brain notes
reason: Upgrade from 3.2.9: preview and apply, preserve host edits and run the installed gate. In a brain with no file having both id and type, plain notes with neither field skip brain.frontmatter and brain.length. Partial nodes and typed brains retain their checks; the inbox frontmatter exemption is unchanged. No other behaviour change. If the install skipped the pre-commit hook, run `node scripts/memory/install-hooks.mjs --repo . --memory-dir <MEMORY_DIR>` once the gate shows 0 FAIL.

title: Kit 3.2.11 memory initialization and staged links
reason: Upgrade from 3.2.10: preview and apply to add memory-init and its installed templates; edited skills and host files are preserved. Run the installed gate. In-repo hooks now resolve checked sibling Markdown targets against the index; upgrade.mjs does not reinstall the unchanged hook script, and updating memory-check.mjs repairs existing hooks. No other behaviour change.

title: Kit 3.2.12 path and initialization fixes
reason: Upgrade from 3.2.11: preview and apply, preserve host edits and run the installed gate. Project path settings stay inside the project; equivalent folder spellings and deleted saved notes folders resolve correctly. Memory initialization removes only its planned entries on rollback and gives clearer first-run instructions. The roadmap overview explains when history has not been created yet.

title: Kit 3.3.0 session wiring
reason: Upgrade from 3.2.12: preview and apply, preserve host edits and run the installed gate. Add /new-session and /handover, keep foreign skills, and refuse incompatible wave-save hooks and unknown owned files.

title: Kit 3.3.1 wrapped gate lines and optional overview
reason: Upgrade from 3.3.0: preview and apply, then run the installed gate. Start replies and /handover reports use grouped bullets and code-formatted paths; failure guidance names the next step. Session phrases no longer splits wrapped bullets; a line 3.3.0 put inside one moves below it. A custom Reports bullet with indented lines is kept with a warning, and one without is replaced by the kit line. In scripts/memory/memory.config.json, caps.roadmapOverview.enabled=false skips overview writing, staging and warnings; upgrades preserve false. --dry-run previews changes; --restore refuses --dry-run and --check before writes. See CHANGELOG for known limits.

title: Kit 3.3.2 explicit lesson citations
reason: Upgrade from 3.3.1: preview and apply, then run the installed gate. Lesson checks now require a numbered Markdown link or the word lesson or lessons before the number. Bare pull-request, deploy and ranking numbers are ignored. A lesson link must use the same number in its text and lesson filename.

title: Kit 3.3.3 topic promotion
reason: promote one-note-per-file topics into numbered lessons. Preview memory-migrate.mjs promote with an explicit map, take a recovery git tag first, then apply with --write. Preserve bodies except reversible filename and link rewrites, rewrite exact probe filenames, and require no recall regressions or new gate FAILs. The census, blind labelling and self-recall tools and LESSON-CONVERSION guides are installed. Promotion scans external references; hot-budget warnings measure topics and pins. Hooks embed their installing engine version; upgrade refreshes existing owned hooks on a best-effort basis to reject older checkout engines before gating.

title: Kit 3.3.4 safe updates and the standard block
reason: Upgrade from 3.3.3: preview with --check first (it lists every planned write), then run upgrade.mjs from the project's main checkout with --live-memory; scripts that call the update must add that flag, and --memory-dir <copy> rehearses without it. The first update sorts the old memory section of AGENTS.md into the kit's standard block and a Project rules section the kit never edits. Lines the kit cannot place stop the update until decided: run instructions-sort.mjs preview, mark each unit keep or drop in decisions.json, then pass it with --instructions-decisions. A same-version run with stale memory exits 3; replay it with --memory-only. Then run the installed gate.

title: Kit 3.3.5 session mode and checkpoint notices
reason: Upgrade from 3.3.4 or 3.3.3: preview with --check first (it lists every planned write), then run upgrade.mjs from the project's main checkout with --live-memory; scripts that call the update keep that flag, and --memory-dir <copy> rehearses without it. The update sets engine_version to 3.3.5 and adds any missing default, keeping every value already set; from 3.3.4 or 3.3.3 that adds three: caps.checkpoint (mode all), caps.index.hotReserveBytes (1024) and caps.router.targetBytes (11264). What a checkpoint commits is unchanged unless caps.checkpoint.mode is session. Every checkpoint run now prints a first line naming the checkout and the memory folder (and, for memory outside the project repo, a closing repo files changed line on runs that are not dry runs), so scripts that parse its output must allow them. A live update now refuses while another session's ledger holds unresolved claims. Then run the installed gate.

title: Kit 3.3.8 plain shipped wording and a home-folder check on every platform
reason: Upgrade from 3.3.7: preview with --check first (it lists every planned write), then run upgrade.mjs from the project's main checkout with --live-memory; scripts that call the update keep that flag, and --memory-dir <copy> rehearses without it.
